headline: Bank Lending Grows 13.21% in October, BI Reveals the Drivers
summary: Bank credit in Indonesia rose 13.21% year on year in October 2026. Bank Indonesia attributed the growth to macroprudential policy and priority sectors.
why: Bank Indonesia is the country's central bank, and loan growth is a key gauge of domestic economic activity and bank earnings.
original_headline: Kredit Perbankan Tumbuh 13,21% di Oktober, BI Ungkap Pendorongnya
